title: Posting the Competition Travel Fee on a UIL Academic and Robotics Team Participation (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**UIL travel fee schedule of Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the travel fee posts under the UIL travel fee schedule, on the date it is posted.

**When the travel fee may post.** The travel fee is posted only after the participation's records log carries the overnight travel permission form from the parent's signed packet. Put the other way round in the same terms: while the participation's records log carries no overnight travel permission form, no travel fee is posted on it.

| Participation's records log | Travel fee |
|---|---|
| carries the overnight travel permission form | posted at the scheduled amount, the day it is posted |
| carries no overnight travel permission form | not posted |

## Invocation: `post_uil_travel_fee_ebd1d9ff`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_uil_travel_fee_ebd1d9ff` and then calls it. The activity office books one new travel fee entry dated today on the participation's fee account; the household's amount due on the participation rises by that amount, and the entry is visible in the fee history with its own reference number and amount.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_participation_id` | reference number of the student's UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation, as returned by the activity participation lookup | identifier |
| `travel_fee_amount` | the travel fee to post, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent (half a cent rounds up); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success: `activity_ledger_id`, the reference number of the new fee entry; `activity_participation_id`; `fee_component` reading `travel_fee`; `amount`, in US dollars with 2 decimal places; `posted_date`, today, YYYY-MM-DD; and `status` reading "posted".

**Error.** A malformed amount returns a `status` of "error" with a message, and nothing is booked. Because the amount must be positive, a travel fee of 0.00 is not booked through this tool.
